name: VQA-RAD: Visual Question Answering in Radiology Dataset
description: VQA-RAD is a foundational benchmark for clinical visual question answering on radiological images. It consists of 3,515 clinician-verified question-answer pairs corresponding to 315 radiology images (head CT, chest X-ray, and abdominal MRI) sourced from MedPix. Questions evaluate free-form natural language clinical reasoning, abnormal finding localization, and anatomical organ identification.
